Advance measured successor selection and bounded host-loss recovery. Fresh eligible peers prepare within five seconds; all recovery attempts share one 15-second budget. Only a fresh prepared peer can commit, and failure is terminal.

asciichat_error_t consensus_handoff_receive
  (consensus_handoff_t * s, const consensus_handoff_message_t * m,
  size_t length, uint64_t now)


Accept a member's probe or preparation reply using receiver-clock
    time. Probe metadata becomes eligible only with a matched, timely body.
    Preparation replies must match the current generation, round, and selected
    successor.


Returns


ASCIICHAT_OK if accepted, or a protocol error without
  accepting the frame.

bool consensus_handoff_tick (consensus_handoff_t *
  s, uint64_t now, consensus_handoff_message_t * a)


Advance measured successor selection and bounded host-loss
    recovery. Fresh eligible peers prepare within five seconds; all recovery
    attempts share one 15-second budget. Only a fresh prepared peer can commit,
    and failure is terminal.


Parameters


now Monotonic receiver time in milliseconds.


a Output action to send when the function returns true.


Returns


True if a PREPARE, COMMIT, or terminal FAILED action was
  produced.
